activity: Combustion of natural gas in homes and buildings
notes: Confirmed from LFP GHG Inventory Report Table 3. Residential 17029 + commercial 1978. Largest single building source; PSE-provided consumption x utility EFs. 20% of communitywide 2019.

activity: Grid electricity consumed in homes and buildings
notes: Confirmed from GHG Inventory Report Table 3. Residential 922 + commercial 127. 98-99% supplied by Seattle City Light (low-carbon hydro), so emissions are small relative to consumption. 1% of communitywide 2019.

notes: Confirmed from GHG Inventory Report (Figure 6). Estimated from WA EIA consumption scaled by population x EPA EF Hub factors. Residential is the largest contributor.

activity: Gasoline/diesel combustion in on-road vehicles (in-boundary + transboundary)
notes: Confirmed from GHG Inventory Report Table 3 (matches Fehr & Peers VMT Study). Includes Scope 1 in-boundary + Scope 3 transboundary; >90% of LFP VMT is transboundary. PSRC travel demand model + StreetLight adjustment. 26% of communitywide 2019.

activity: Air travel allocated to LFP residents
notes: Confirmed from GHG Inventory Report Table 3. SeaTac jet-A fuel volume allocated to cities by passenger survey + population + median household income. Largest single emissions source — 33% of communitywide 2019. BASIC+ Scope 3.

Confirmed from GHG Inventory Report Table 3. EPA MOVES model run at county level scaled by city population. Construction, industrial, and lawn/garden equipment dominate. 6% of communitywide 2019. BASIC+.

activity: Generation and disposal of landfilled waste
notes: Confirmed from GHG Inventory Report Table 3. City/municipal tonnage + King County waste characterization x EPA WARM factors. Exported waste = Scope 3. 77% of solid waste sector.

activity: Generation and disposal of composted waste
notes: Confirmed from GHG Inventory Report Table 3. EPA WARM factors. 23% of solid waste sector. GPC biological treatment.

activity: Fugitive refrigerant leakage from cooling equipment
notes: Confirmed from GHG Inventory Report Table 3. Estimated from EPA national GHG inventory scaled by population. High-GWP HFCs from AC and refrigeration. 7% of communitywide 2019. BASIC+ (reported as IPPU here).

activity: Emissions from tree canopy loss / land conversion
